title: Regent Ysolde's dialogue menu shrinks as questions are asked, so a later option keeps the same number a different, more consequential option used to have. Re-pressing option 6 out of habit (meaning to ask 'the Hearthlands' tithe') actually fired 'bury the burn-order (breaks the oath)', permanently failing the Marshal's quest and costing Vell -1 regard, with no confirmation prompt for an irreversible, oath-breaking action.
where: Marrowgate / The Regent's Chambers, talk to Regent Ysolde
